phase: Phase 16 item 4 — resident session given narrow_probe's cache-first short-circuit
headline_result: NEGATIVE: resident+probe does NOT beat cold+probe overall or in the 50-100MiB / >100MiB strata. It wins only below ~1MiB (as before). The probe removed the per-observation cost but the session's one-time full descriptor open dominates.

seam.refactor: narrow_probe is now the cold wrapper (reads the manifest + opens the index store) around narrow_probe_core; the cold observe path is otherwise unchanged.
seam.hoisting: observe_session probes with the manifest of the already-open Field and an FsIndexStore the session keeps open in a new field (DocumentFieldSession.index). Ctx.istore became a borrow so the eval core reuses the same open index store.
seam.answer_contract: session answer == cold answer (FieldAnswer equality); ObserveStats may differ

answer_equality_real_corpus.comparison: cold observe --page 1 --kind text vs resident observe-batch (last line of the repeated batch)

mechanism.finding: the resident batch cost equals the session's one-time open; extra observations add ~nothing
mechanism.evidence: raw/mechanism.txt — nasa-pdf-0004 (76,790,177-byte descriptor): observe-batch repeat=1 = 0.14 s, repeat=5 = 0.14 s; cold single observe = 0.00 s
mechanism.per_observation: resident batch observations 2..N report descriptor_bytes_read=0, descriptor_read_mode=partial, wall_micros ~24-28 us
mechanism.probe_hits: 208/360 observations 2..N of the batches were cache-served short-circuits (raw/answer-equality.txt)
mechanism.cause: DocumentFieldSession::open calls Field::open, which reads AND parses the whole descriptor; the cold path's narrow_probe never opens the descriptor at all. One full parse of a tens-of-MB descriptor exceeds REPEAT_N process spawns of a probe-only process.

cold_vs_resident_text_repeat.units: wall milliseconds; resident = one observe-batch doing REPEAT_N=5 observations; cold = 5 separate observe processes (sum). Verdict uses the frozen court rule (fastest median, +/-10% tie band). Answered docs only (rc==0).

1-10MiB.verdict: cold by median; resident by sum

10-50MiB.verdict: cold by median; resident by sum (epub wins, pdf loses)

overall_answered.cold_wins: 38/90 (resident faster on the other 52, but cold wins the median and the sum)

overall_all_rows.note: matches the Phase 15.2 receipt's all-rows 7 vs 9 ms quote

resident_median_by_class_prev_then_new.>100MiB: 353.5 -> 370.0 (confounded: n 2 -> 3, phase16.3 fixed the >100MiB memory pathology)

vs_previous_receipt_78f7ea8.verdict: the probe gives the resident lane a small improvement (~5-12% on the large-PDF strata) but flips nothing; every prior win/loss class is unchanged
vs_previous_receipt_78f7ea8.caveat: the previous receipt is commit 78f7ea8; this run is 5d331f2 (includes phase16.1/16.2/16.3). The mechanism capture (repeat=1 == repeat=5) isolates the probe's own effect and is commit-independent.

identified_but_out_of_scope: the session's eager full-descriptor open. A lazy session open (open only the manifest at session start; load the descriptor only on a probe miss) is the change that could make residency pay for large descriptors, but the user scoped this experiment to giving the session narrow_probe's short-circuit and explicitly said not to reopen the broader residency thesis.
